status_note_zh: 概念设计阶段示例账本；12 项当前均为未核权、候选、G0、未开放，须完成权利核验后才可进入后续测试。
status_note_en: Concept-design example ledger; all twelve entries are currently unreviewed candidates at G0 and not open, and must clear rights review before any later test.

title.zh: 如何让开放模型在公共场景中接受可理解的验证？
title.en: How can open models undergo understandable validation in public settings?

success_conditions.zh: 测试边界、数据来源和人工责任人同时公开
success_conditions.en: Test limits, data provenance and the accountable human are published together

stop_conditions.zh: 出现未授权数据、不可解释高风险输出或无法人工接管
stop_conditions.en: Stop for unauthorized data, unexplained high-risk output or failed human takeover

expiry_policy.zh: 每 90 天复核；未通过 G1 即归档
expiry_policy.en: Review every 90 days; archive if G1 is not passed

title.zh: 具身 AI 能否在隔离、低速和人工接管条件下安全测试？
title.en: Can embodied AI be tested safely with separation, low speed and human takeover?

problem_owner.zh: 小月河试验场联合运营组

success_conditions.zh: 速度、隔离距离、接管人和事故上报路径在模拟审查界面清楚可见
success_conditions.en: Speed, separation, takeover owner and incident-reporting route are clearly visible in the simulated review interface

stop_conditions.zh: 未来封闭测试一旦出现越界、失联或未遂碰撞即停止；未清楚标示测试状态则不得进入公众环境
stop_conditions.en: Any future closed test stops after a geofence breach, lost link or near miss; unclear status blocks entry into a public setting

expiry_policy.zh: 若未来取得单次测试许可，到期即关闭；重新测试须重新通过相应闸门
expiry_policy.en: If a future single-test permit is granted, close at expiry; any retest must pass the relevant gate again

title.zh: 建筑能源影子模型怎样只辅助判断而不替代专业审查？
title.en: How can an energy shadow model support decisions without replacing professional review?

problem_owner.zh: 园区设施与节能联合组

success_conditions.zh: 模型假设、误差区间与人工复核结果同步展示
success_conditions.en: Assumptions, error bands and human review are displayed together

stop_conditions.zh: 基础台账缺失或模型结论被直接用于工程指令
stop_conditions.en: Stop if base records are missing or model output becomes a direct engineering order

expiry_policy.zh: 每个采暖制冷季结束后复核模型
expiry_policy.en: Review after every heating or cooling season

title.zh: 科研助手如何让引用、版本和不确定性一眼可查？
title.en: How can a research assistant make citations, versions and uncertainty immediately inspectable?

success_conditions.zh: 每条关键结论携带出处、访问时间和人工核验状态
success_conditions.en: Every material claim carries a source, access date and human-review status

stop_conditions.zh: 来源不可访问、引用错配或无法区分事实与推断
stop_conditions.en: Stop for inaccessible sources, citation mismatch or blurred fact/inference

expiry_policy.zh: 知识库每月冻结版本，过期答案保留审计记录
expiry_policy.en: Freeze a monthly knowledge-base version and retain expired answers for audit

title.zh: 国际人才服务怎样在多语提示后可靠转接人工？
title.en: How can international-talent services hand off reliably after multilingual guidance?

success_conditions.zh: 用户可随时选择人工、纸面或现场办理路径
success_conditions.en: Users can choose human, paper or on-site service at any point

stop_conditions.zh: 错误翻译影响权利事项或人工转介不可达
stop_conditions.en: Stop if mistranslation affects rights or human referral is unavailable

expiry_policy.zh: 服务事项或政策变化时立即复核
expiry_policy.en: Review immediately when a service item or policy changes

title.zh: 算力与数据服务如何公开资格、价格口径和投诉入口？
title.en: How can compute and data services disclose eligibility, pricing basis and complaint routes?

problem_owner.zh: 中关村专业服务协作组

success_conditions.zh: 服务目录同时公开提供方、适用条件、费用口径和人工咨询
success_conditions.en: The directory lists provider, conditions, pricing basis and human consultation together

stop_conditions.zh: 广告代替事实说明或无法识别利益关系
stop_conditions.en: Stop if advertising replaces factual disclosure or conflicts are hidden

expiry_policy.zh: 条目每月确认，逾期自动下线
expiry_policy.en: Confirm monthly; automatically unpublish overdue entries

title.zh: 文化伴游怎样兼顾无障碍、人工讲解和遗产信息边界？
title.en: How can cultural guidance combine accessibility, human interpretation and heritage-information limits?

problem_owner.zh: 京张文化线索公共服务筹备组

public_beneficiaries.zh: 老年人与儿童同行家庭
public_beneficiaries.en: Older visitors and families with children

success_conditions.zh: 现场提供清晰导向、人工讲解与非智能服务选择
success_conditions.en: Clear wayfinding, human interpretation and non-smart service remain available

stop_conditions.zh: 把临时范围写成遗址公园正式边界或无障碍服务不可用
stop_conditions.en: Stop if provisional extents are presented as official heritage boundaries or accessible service fails

human_owner_role.zh: 文化服务与无障碍协调员

expiry_policy.zh: 路线或展陈变化时重新审核全部内容
expiry_policy.en: Re-review all content when routes or exhibits change

title.zh: 公民观察怎样保留原始记录、复核误判并保护敏感物种？
title.en: How can civic observation retain originals, review misidentification and protect sensitive species?

problem_owner.zh: 小月河生态观察协作组

success_conditions.zh: 原始照片、模型建议和专家复核结果分层保存
success_conditions.en: Original media, model suggestions and expert review are stored as separate layers

stop_conditions.zh: 敏感物种坐标公开或错误识别持续误导公众
stop_conditions.en: Stop if sensitive-species coordinates are exposed or persistent errors mislead the public

expiry_policy.zh: 敏感物种坐标默认不公开；观察季结束后只发布脱敏汇总
expiry_policy.en: Sensitive-species coordinates remain private by default; publish only a redacted seasonal summary

title.zh: AI 产品说明卡能否让公众在体验前看懂数据与风险？
title.en: Can AI product cards explain data and risk before public use?

problem_owner.zh: 南段产品体验概念点筹备组

success_conditions.zh: 说明卡列出提供方、数据边界、主要风险、投诉入口、现场人工帮助与停止使用方式；人工帮助和停止方式是本方案的服务设计
success_conditions.en: Cards name the provider, data limits, main risks, complaint route, on-site human help and a way to stop using the service; the last two are design choices in this proposal

stop_conditions.zh: 高风险功能无现场责任人或说明卡与实际版本不一致
stop_conditions.en: Stop if a high-risk function lacks an on-site owner or the card mismatches the live version

expiry_policy.zh: 产品每次版本更新均须重新登记

title.zh: 中小商户怎样在保留人工确认的前提下使用内容与翻译工具？
title.en: How can small merchants use content and translation tools while retaining human approval?

problem_owner.zh: 南段商户支持概念点筹备组

success_conditions.zh: 发布前由商户确认事实、价格与译文，生成内容有清晰标识
success_conditions.en: Merchants verify facts, prices and translations before labeled generated content is published

stop_conditions.zh: 虚构商品信息、错误价格或无法追溯最终确认人
stop_conditions.en: Stop for fabricated product facts, wrong prices or an untraceable final approver

stop_conditions.zh: 把 PROV-KEY-003 表述为已锚定大钟寺站
stop_conditions.en: Stop if PROV-KEY-003 is presented as anchored to Dazhongsi Station

expiry_policy.zh: 如进入临时活动，活动结束即关闭临时内容库
expiry_policy.en: If a temporary campaign proceeds, close its content store when the campaign ends

title.zh: 公共空间舒适度改造怎样让少数意见进入设计复盘？
title.en: How can minority feedback enter public-space comfort redesign?

problem_owner.zh: 全带公共空间维护协作组

public_beneficiaries.zh: 儿童、老年人与残障使用者

success_conditions.zh: 线上意见、现场访谈与观察记录共同形成公开的设计变更记录
success_conditions.en: Online comments, on-site interviews and observations produce a public record of design changes

stop_conditions.zh: 只有线上样本、无法提供人工反馈渠道或改造造成通行障碍
stop_conditions.en: Stop for online-only samples, no human feedback route or a new access barrier

expiry_policy.zh: 每个季节结束发布复盘，未采纳意见说明原因
expiry_policy.en: Publish a seasonal retrospective and reasons for declined feedback

title.zh: 社区问题如何分流到明确责任人并留下公开回执？
title.en: How can community problems reach a named owner and leave a public receipt?

public_beneficiaries.zh: 社区居民与沿线使用者

success_conditions.zh: 每个受理问题获得分类、责任角色、下一节点和公开状态
success_conditions.en: Every accepted issue receives a category, accountable role, next step and public status

stop_conditions.zh: 收集敏感个人信息、无人负责或公开状态与实际处置不一致
stop_conditions.en: Stop for sensitive personal data, missing ownership or a public status that diverges from action

expiry_policy.zh: 本方案建议 30 天无进展时升级；90 天仍无责任主体则公开说明并关闭，不将该期限解释为法规要求
expiry_policy.en: This proposal suggests escalation after 30 inactive days and a public, reasoned closure after 90 days without an owner; these periods are not statutory deadlines
